summary: Independent structural/statistical decode of Formats/Latest (racbasic Formats__Latest.gz/000.bin, 498,766 B, sha256-identical in all six samples). Derived the full record/field-descriptor grammar from record-boundary alignment + inter-field gap statistics, and calibrated the scalar type-tag codebook from the schema's own synthetic std::pair<A,B> classes (their `second` field's tag = tag for B). Result: the faithful prefix 0x0–0x21DFA (27.8%) parses exhaustively into 1,150 class records (727 top-level, alphabetical A→DC3DGraphicsSettings, plus 423 inline-defined bases/element types incl. 77 std::pair<> synthetics), 3,111 fields, with 100% byte tiling, 423/423 inline-definition ordinal cross-checks (ordinal = 12 + definition index), and zero unaccounted A-CamelCase identifiers. HEADLINE CROSS-CUTTING FINDING: the remaining 72.2% of the stream is scrambled at the source — a token-level deflate decode shows short LZ matches stitched from scattered window positions, a single 38-byte record header (DBView3dEnergyAnalysis) duplicated verbatim >=30 times, field density collapsing to ~0 per 8 KiB window, non-matching gzip CRC/ISIZE, and the identical collapse in Revit family samples 2016–2026. Diagnosis: writer-side LZ-encoder defect; class records after 'DDG...' are unrecoverable from this stream in any file. Deliverables: src/rvt/schema_b.py (parser + statistics + degraded-region characterisation, emits extracted/_schema/schema_b.json), docs/streams/01-schema-b.md (grammar with hex worked examples, tag codebook, class inventory, inheritance/reference model, agreement metrics, degradation evidence, unknowns), plus inbox note.
key_findings: Record grammar (LE): u16 marker=0, u16 nameLen+name, u16 baseRef (0=none; 0x8000|ord = base defined inline as nested record), u32 version, u32 fieldCount, fields (u32 nameLen+name+typedesc), u32 nGuid + n*16B GUIDs. Top-level records tile the faithful prefix with zero gap bytes (138,746/138,746).

Class references are ORDINALS not offsets: ordinals start at 12 and increment in definition order; a flagged ref 0x8000|N means class N is defined inline right there. Verified: all 423 flagged references == 12 + definition_index (0 mismatches). ElementId = ordinal 20, referenced as `0e 00 00 00 14 00` in 735 by-value fields (most-referenced class, 611 refs).

Typedesc = u8 kind, u8 mod, u16 pad(=0), then payload: class kinds (0e) take u16 ref (mods 00/50/10; 10 adds u32 count), pointer mods 01/02/03/51/11 carry NO static class ref; scalar kinds are bare 4-byte tags; mod 10 adds u32 count; kind 0d wraps a nested typedesc (u32 count?, u32 k=1, u8 0x20, inner desc [+u16 ref if class]). Descriptor lengths established by gap statistics between consecutive field names.

Scalar codebook calibrated from std::pair<> synthetic class names (80 samples, 0 conflicts): 01=bool, 04=int (and unsigned int), 05=unsigned long, 06=float, 07=double, 08+mod60=AString, 09=GUID, 0b=Int64, 0e=class; hypotheses: 02=16-bit/enum, 03=long/enum32, 0a=ClassDefinitionRef. Modifiers: 00 value, 01/02/03 pointer flavours, 10 fixed array, 11 pointer array, 50 container, 51 pointer container, 60 string.

Independent corroboration: m_pX field names carry pointer tags 129/129, m_oX 161/162; every A-CamelCase/type-string u16 identifier in the prefix (1,148) is a parsed record name; per-record version histogram v1:469, v0:318, v2:144; ADocument version 2662 with 19 fields and a 1,509-GUID trailer.

Class inventory (prefix): 1,150 classes, ordinals 12..1161, 698 inheritance edges, 452 roots, max depth 6; top bases Element(89), GeomStep(63), Cell(54), AppInfo(32); most common field types int 534, ElementId 468, bool 354, double 311, untyped ptr 306, AString 156, container<ElementId> 129, double[3] 85.
26 classes end with unique GUID trailer lists (1,555 GUIDs total, all distinct): ADocument 1,509, AUnits 13, WitnessRefInfo 3, Element/Dimension/ParamElem 2, others 1 — semantics unknown.

CRITICAL: bytes 0x21E64..EOF (72.2%) are scrambled at write time — deflate-token forensics show scattered short matches; the DBView3dEnergyAnalysis 38-byte header (true copy 0x20A7E) recurs >=30 times; well-formed-field density per 8 KiB collapses 165-236 -> 13,7,9,...0; gzip CRC/ISIZE mismatch; zlib level-3 recompression reproduces the first 41,152 compressed bytes exactly; identical collapse in every Revit release 2016-2026 (family samples). Writer-side LZ encoder defect: schema classes alphabetically after 'DDGraphSerializable' are unrecoverable from this stream in any of the six files.
Formats/Latest inflated content is byte-identical (sha256 36c6ea9711ced9ee...) across all six 2026 samples; re-extraction via olefile confirmed.
confidence: High for the faithful-prefix grammar, ordinal model, class inventory, and pair<>-calibrated tag codebook (multiple independent 100% self-consistency checks: byte tiling, 423/423 ordinal cross-checks, 0-conflict ground truth, naming correlation). High for the empirical fact that 72% of the stream is unrecoverable garbage (density profile, verbatim record duplication, valid-deflate-to-EOF, cross-version reproduction). Medium/hypothesis for the root-cause diagnosis (writer-side LZ encoder desync) and for the meanings of kinds 02/03/0a, pointer-flavour mods 01/02/03, the per-record version field, the 0d-wrapper k/0x20 bytes, and the trailer GUID lists.
open_questions: Where can the schema classes alphabetically after 'DDGraphSerializable' (~72% of the dictionary) be recovered? Not from Formats/Latest in any sample; candidates: another Revit release with a shorter faithful window, reconstruction from Global/Latest and Partitions object data, or live Revit API introspection.

Root cause of the tail scrambling: is it a defective home-grown deflate writer (window/hash desync with unverified matches) as evidenced, or something else? Does the same encoder degrade any Global/* or Partitions gzip member (all seen so far are <139 KB, possibly inside the safe range)?
Exact C++ types for kinds 02 (16-bit/enum?), 03 (long/enum32?), 0a (ClassDefinitionRef.m_ref); kind 04 conflates int/unsigned int.
Semantics of pointer modifiers 01 vs 02 vs 03 and container 50 vs 51; existence/meaning of mods 40/52/61/62 (never seen in the faithful prefix).
Meaning of the per-record u32 version, the u32 k(=1) and u8 0x20 bytes inside 0d10/0d50 wrappers, and whether ordinals 0..11 are the built-in kinds 00..0b.
Semantics of trailer GUID lists (why 26 classes; ADocument's 1,509 unique GUIDs vs total serializable class count).

Hunt an alternate schema source for the missing 72%: extract Formats/Latest from other Revit releases (family samples 2016-2025 in vendor/phi-ag-rvt/examples) — their faithful windows may cover different alphabetic ranges; also mine class names/GUIDs from Global/Latest and Partitions data.
